name: Landing Page Copy
description: Produces conversion-optimized landing page copy with hero section, problem statement, solution, social proof, and CTA sections using conversion copywriting methodology. Use when the user asks to write landing page copy, create a product page, write a sales page, draft conversion copy, or write landing page text for a website. Also useful when asked to write website copy or create a page that converts visitors. Do NOT use for ad copy (use paid-ad-copy), product descriptions for e-commerce listings (use product-description), or full website content strategy (use seo-content-strategy).
